title: HAProxy
subtitle: A high-performance TCP and HTTP load balancer with health checks and failover.

tiles.label: Bind & modes
tiles.says: HAProxy takes the frontend and binds listeners in tcp or http mode.
tiles.detail: Each frontend accepts connections on addresses and ports, with TLS if needed. Layer 4 or 7 mode is chosen per workload.

tiles.label: ACLs & rules
tiles.says: ACLs match requests; use_backend picks the destination.
tiles.detail: Conditions on host, path, headers or source address select a backend. Routing rules stay readable and testable.

tiles.label: PROXY protocol
tiles.says: PROXY protocol carries the true client address forward.
tiles.detail: Backends and chained proxies learn original client IPs without header rewriting, keeping logs and access rules accurate.

tiles.label: Balancing
tiles.says: HAProxy balances upstreams to the backend with chosen algorithms.
tiles.detail: Roundrobin, leastconn and source hashing spread load. Stickiness uses cookies or stick tables when sessions matter.

tiles.label: Health checks
tiles.says: Active checks remove dead servers within seconds.
tiles.detail: TCP, HTTP and agent checks control rotation with rise and fall counters. Failures are contained before users notice.

tiles.label: Drain & maintenance
tiles.says: Servers drain gracefully for zero-downtime changes.
tiles.detail: The runtime API sets servers to drain or maint. Deploys and patching happen during working hours without outages.

tiles.label: VRRP floating IP
tiles.says: keepalived moves a virtual address between nodes.
tiles.detail: Priority-based election keeps one MASTER holding the VIP. If it fails the BACKUP takes over within seconds.

tiles.label: Stats & runtime
tiles.says: The stats page and runtime API expose live state.
tiles.detail: Session rates, queue depth and server status feed monitoring and give operators control without restarts.

tiles.label: Seamless reload
tiles.says: A reload hands listening sockets to a new process.
tiles.detail: Configuration changes apply without dropping established connections, so changes are routine.

declarations: HAProxy balances; it does not serve content.
Health checks decide who receives traffic.
One floating IP, one active load balancer.
